title: A semi-realistic p · @sandmrk
prompt:
A semi-realistic painterly digital illustration of a young adult East Asian beauty in a temple courtyard, vertical 9:16, framed from mid-thigh up, camera at her upper-chest height. This is an illustration, NOT a photograph and NOT a 3D render.
soft airbrushed porcelain skin in smooth painterly gradients with large soft specular sheens, no photographic pores or sharp detail; hair in silky flowing masses with bright rim light and fine flyaway strands; crimson silk with soft painted reflections; a dreamy luminous bloom of NEUTRAL WHITE sunlight glowing from the upper right, highlights haloed and hazy; every surface keeps the gentle velvety softness of a high-end digital painting — smooth-blended, never coarse brushstroke grain, never oil-paint texture.
clean midday light, slightly cool white balance: highlights WHITE, shadows soft blue-grey and lavender; skin porcelain pale with pink in it, never tanned or golden; the crimson a true deep red with blue depth, maroon in the folds, pale rose-white on fold edges; gold muted antique; peonies ivory-cream with pink shading; roof tiles blue-grey, foliage fresh green, pillar clear vermilion; NO amber cast, NO golden-hour wash.
a youthful soft oval face, full cheeks, large stylized eyes with detailed grey-green irises and thick painted lashes; her face turns three-quarter to frame-left, her chin lowered about ten degrees; from beneath her lowered lids her eyes RAISE up and to frame-left by about twenty-five degrees, a crescent of lower sclera showing — wistful, dreamy, longing, as if gazing up at someone taller; inner brows faintly lifted; lips a glossy coral-red, softly parted with a sliver of teeth; a soft pink blush high on her cheekbones; one fine strand of hair blows diagonally across her forehead and right cheek.
her torso turns three-quarter to frame-right; head box x31–74% / y0–21% of the frame; her RIGHT hand at frame-left (box x12–27% / y60–77%) pinches the skirt hem between thumb and fingers, the cloth gathered by the grip; her LEFT hand (box x50–70% / y55–75%) lies open and flat on the front of her thigh over the skirt's slit, fingers together pointing down; exactly two arms and two hands, five fingers on each, hand length equal to face length, middle finger longest.
dark chocolate-brown hair, half up with a plain low loose bun at the back frame-left side; two long straight falls pour over the front of both shoulders to below her waist; the loose mass behind streams horizontally to frame-right in the wind, edge strands catching pale white glints.
a crimson silk HALTER gown: thin crimson straps edged in gold rise from the deep V's top corners to a small gold bow-knot clasp with one pearl at the center of her throat; the deep V is edged in cream lace, and at its bottom point (about x33% / y54%) hangs a gold embroidered medallion with a pearl drop; a large cream peony blooms on her left chest, dark-green foliage and gold vines trail down the torso, a small white flower at her right waist, another large cream peony at her left hip, the vine embroidery continuing into the lower skirt; a high slit over her left leg edged with cream lace; a full bust line carried by the halter bodice, a fine tapered waist. Over her left forearm drapes a sheer cream shawl with gold embroidered borders, billowing behind her to the right frame edge, a matching cream drape over her right forearm. Jewelry: pearl-drop gold earrings at both ears, ONE fine gold chain necklace with a pearl pendant and a teardrop pearl drop, thin gold bangles on her right wrist.
a vermilion lacquered pillar at the frame-left edge (x0–16%), blurred fresh green leaves at the lower left, blue-grey tiled roofs and muted painted beams across the upper background with moderate painted detail; bright daylight from the upper right, a few soft leaf-shadow dapples on her right arm and the dress front, one bright sun patch on her thigh.

Negative: no photograph, no photorealistic, no 3D render, no CGI game look, no amber cast, no golden-hour light, no yellow skin, no orange red, no coarse brushstrokes, no oil-paint grain, no photographic pores, no text besides the signature, no logo, no extra people, no extra arms, no extra hands, no extra or fused fingers, no distorted joints, no alert direct gaze, no raised chin, no neutral expression.
Signature: "AI art gallery | @sandmrk" exactly once, bottom center, Montserrat Regular, pure white, +1.5px letter spacing, 2% image height, max width 25% of image width, 10% above bottom edge, no shadow, outline, glow or background.
